scope: Bounded visual comparison of the November 5 dispatch reference at v02-u001742 and the November 6 No. 11 bis dateline at v02-u001365. The printed and four digital witnesses preserve the respective dates. No reconstruction of actual dispatch history or whole-volume printed collation is claimed.
edition: Mémoires du prince de Talleyrand, II; Duc de Broglie; Paris: Calmann Lévy, 1891.
method: Printed grayscale page images were visually inspected. Printed page 515 was rendered at 200 dpi with pdftoppm; the page 419 heading/dateline excerpt is byte-identical to the earlier excerpt from the same scanned edition. The full page 515 image is not retained or bundled; its recorded SHA-256 is preserved. No OCR-only conclusion.
conclusion: Print preserves both readings: La dépêche du 5 novembre au département on p.515, and Vienne, le 6 novembre 1814 under No 11 bis on p.419. The four digital HTML/TXT witnesses agree at both locations. This facsimile supplies no different numeral or corrective date.
